newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Abu Dhabi Investment Company along with other insurance firms agrees to form a reinsurance company in the United Arab Emirates with $150 million in capital.
- Oman signs agreement to export 4.1 million tonnes of gas to Korea.
- A new sugar plant in Saudi Arabia will satisfy 80 percent of local needs. It is due to be opened in 1997.
- Bahrain Industry and Oil minister in discussions to boost French drilling works in Bahrain.
- A $12 million European loan for water projects in Jordan from the European Investment Bank.
- Saudi-Tunisian Investment Company contributes to 310 projects in Tunis.
